An '''assault''' on [[Dezono Qua]] [[Qua family's villa|villa]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]], occurred in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. The raid was carried by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dass Jennir]] and the crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' in order to rescue the [[Resa Greenbark|daughter]] of [[Bomo Greenbark]].
